articles.headline: AC Milan condemn racist abuse of Mike Maignan after red card vs. Bournemouth
articles.description: AC Milan have condemned what they called "serious and unacceptable racist abuse" directed at goalkeeper Mike Maignan on social media following his red card in Thursday's Europa League loss to Bournemouth.

articles.headline: 'If Mo Salah scores three...' - Hearts boss on puzzle to mark Trabzonspor star
articles.description: Wouter Vrancken hailed auxiliary left-back Rogers Mato for the way he stepped into the breach against Mohamed Salah as injury-hit Hearts produced a spirited display in a 2-0 Conference League defeat away to Trabzonspor.

articles.headline: Rose urges humility after Bournemouth rout Milan as Amorim rues red card
articles.description: Marco Rose said his Bournemouth team will stay humble after they dominated AC Milan 3-0 in the Europa League while Ruben Amorim said the match was over as a contest for his team after Mike Maignan's red card in the first half.

article.story:
Bruno Fernandes netted a hat trick as Manchester United eased to a 4-1 win over Real Sociedad to reach the Europa League quarterfinals.

United will face Lyon in the last eight after the French side strolled to a 4-0 win over Steaua Bucharest.

Manchester United, who drew 1-1 at Sociedad in the first leg,went a goal down after 10 minutes when Matthijs de Ligt fouled Mikel Oyarzabal and Oyarzabal converted from the spot but the hosts levelled six minutes later with a penalty of their own scored by Fernandes after Igor Zubeldia had fouled Rasmus Højlund.

Another spot-kick gave United the lead five minutes after the interval, with Aritz Elustondo adjudged to have fouled Patrick Dorgu and Fernandes again made no mistake.

Sociedad were reduced to 10 men when Jon Aramburu fouled Joshua Zirkzee and Fernandes completed his hat trick and Diogo Dalot wrapped up a 5-2 aggregate victory for United in added time.

"This club is all about winning," Fernandes told TNT Sports.

"Confidence is a big thing in football and at this club even more because you know how much you are on the eyes of everyone so you need to perform at the highest level."
